Scene 01 / 06
DAWN
Gold floods the horizon. The ocean catches fire — warm amber and peach across every swell.
Scene 02 / 06
MIDDAY
Full light. The sea turns a deep cerulean, scattering white specular across every swell.
Scene 03 / 06
DUSK
The sun descends in copper and ember. Long reflections stretch across the darkening water.
Scene 04 / 06
STORM
Waves amplify. The sky thickens. A darkness that isn't night — something coming from the west.
Scene 05 / 06
NIGHT
Stars emerge. The moon leaves a silver path on the swells. Nothing moves but the ocean.
Scene 06 / 06
PRE-DAWN
The last stars hold. A red-orange ember glows at the edge of the world, not yet a sun.
